data.name: Subject Zero : Benzene Protocol
data.detailed_description:
Subject Zero : Benzene Protocol is a punishing first-person action roguelite where your greatest enemy isn't just the monsters, it's the game itself. Set in a world ravaged by a catastrophic biological leak, you must scavenge, adapt, and evolve to survive.

Evolve to Survive

Death is only the beginning of the protocol. Collect Benzene and data fragments during your runs to unlock permanent enhancements in a massive Meta-Progression Skill Tree.

  • Master the GAS: Customize your survivor with specialized Gameplay Abilities.

  • Specialized Nodes: Invest points into health regeneration, tactical speed, or lethal elemental damage.

  • Persistent Power: Carry your strength from one failed run to the next until you become the ultimate survivor.

Tactical Scavenging & Extraction

Every second counts. The Survival Timer dictates the world’s lethality. The longer you stay in the hot zone, the higher the Difficulty Scale climbs. Balance the risk of staying for better loot against the absolute necessity of extracting before the mutation reaches its peak.

The AI Director: A Predator that Learns

Forget predictable spawn patterns. Our custom AI Director monitors your performance in real-time. The better you play, the harder it hits. It manages the intensity of the hordes, the frequency of vagues, and the evolution of mutants to ensure that no two runs are ever the same. If you stop to catch your breath, it’s already planning your next ambush.

Key Features:

  • Dynamic Scaling: A difficulty system that reacts to your pace, not just a timer.

  • Strategic Roguelite Loops: Fast-paced combat sessions where every death teaches you something new.

  • High-Stakes Environments: Explore haunting, procedurally-influenced tiles where resources are scarce and danger is constant.

  • Deep Customization: Build your character your way through an intricate talent system and diverse ability sets.

data.short_description: Face an ever-evolving nightmare where no two runs are the same. In this brutal survival roguelite, you must extract vital resources and outsmart an adaptive AI that scales difficulty to your every move. Unlock permanent upgrades and customize your build to overcome the ultimate biological threat.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bits
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 ou AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6 Go ou AMD Radeon RX 580 8 Go
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64 bits
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-12700K ou AMD Ryzen 7 7700X
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 ou AMD Radeon RX 7800 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 30 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: Subject Zero : Benzene Protocol features intense combat against mutated humanoids and monstrous creatures. Players use firearms and tactical abilities to eliminate enemies, resulting in frequent depictions of blood, dismemberment, and visceral gore. The game world portrays a grim, post-apocalyptic atmosphere with environmental storytelling that may include scenes of biological devastation and corpses. There are no depictions of sexual assault, non-consensual sexual content, or self-harm.
